# MaskExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Show/hide layer objects by a geofence.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/mask-extension",
  "type": "MaskExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/mask-extension').par.maskId` (an input) and `op('/mask-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.maskId`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |

| `maskId` | `StringField` | `""` |
| `maskByInstance` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
